channel.title: Burkina Faso - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Burkina Faso, every source cited.

item.title: Ouagadougou hosts 18th international crafts fair
item.description: The 18th edition of the Salon international de l’artisanat de Ouagadougou (SIAO) will run from October 30 to November 8, 2026.

item.title: Ouagadougou hosts tribute to Professor Idrissa Ouédraogo
item.description: Academics from Mali, Niger, Senegal, and Canada will join Burkinabe scholars to discuss informal sector development.

item.title: African cardiologists meet in Ouagadougou

item.title: Burkina Faso seeks Indonesian partnerships for resource transformation
item.description: Over 35 Burkinabe business people attended the Trade Expo Indonesia 2026 in Jakarta to explore trade and investment opportunities.

item.title: Burkina Faso explores nuclear tech for farming
item.description: Scientists and officials met in Ouagadougou to discuss how nuclear techniques can boost crop yields and improve soil and water management.
